title: Mayonnaise
description: A classic French cold emulsified mother sauce made from egg yolk, neutral oil, mustard, and lemon juice or vinegar, forming the base for countless dressings, dips, and derivative sauces.

ingredients.title: For the Mayonnaise
items: 150 ml (⅔ cup) neutral oil (vegetable or grapeseed)
1–2 tsp fresh lemon juice or white wine vinegar

instructions.title: Instruction
steps: Place the egg yolk, Dijon mustard, and a pinch of salt into a mixing bowl and whisk until smooth.
Slowly drizzle in the neutral oil while whisking constantly to create a stable emulsion.
Once the mixture begins to thicken, continue adding the remaining oil in a thin, steady stream.
Whisk in the lemon juice or white wine vinegar until the desired acidity is reached.
Season with salt and white pepper, adjusting mustard or lemon juice if desired.
Transfer to a clean container, cover, and refrigerate until ready to use.

chefTips: Ensure all ingredients are at room temperature for a stable emulsion.
Add the oil very slowly at the beginning to prevent the mayonnaise from splitting.
If the mayonnaise breaks, whisk a fresh egg yolk in a clean bowl and gradually incorporate the split mixture.
Mayonnaise is the base for Aioli, Tartar Sauce, and Rémoulade.
Ideal for sandwiches, potato salads, coleslaw, deviled eggs, seafood dips, and cold meat salads.
